Examples from the Text and Number Identifiers help page.
-- origin --
spec
-- script.mrc --
alias test {
  echo -s r: $abs(-1) $asc(A) $chr(65) $len(#mIRC) $lower(HELLO) $upper(hello)
  echo -s r: $base(15,10,16) $base(1.5,10,16) $base(2,10,16,3)
  echo -s r: $count(hello,l) $left(goodbye,4) $right(othello,5) $mid(othello,3,4)
  echo -s r: $left(goodbye,-3) $longip(158.152.50.239) $longip(2660774639)
  echo -s r: $pos(hello there,e,1) $pos(hello there,e,2) $pos(hello there,e,0)
  echo -s r: $remove(abcdefg,cd) $remove(abcdefg,a,c,e,g) $replace(abcdefg,cd,xyz)
  echo -s r: $replace(abcdefg,a,A,b,B,c,C,d,D) $round(3.14159,2) $str(ho,3) $int(3.14159)
  echo -s r: $calc(3 + 4 * 2) $calc((3 + 4) * 2) $calc(2 ^ 10) $calc(10 / 4) $calc(1 / 3)
  echo -s r: $calc(7 % 3) $calc(7 // 2) $calc(-3 + 1) $calc($null + 2)
  echo -s r: $ord(1) $ord(2) $ord(3) $ord(11) $ord(22) $qt(hi) $noqt("hi")
  echo -s r: $min(3 1 2) $max(3,1,2) $and(12,10) $or(12,10) $xor(12,10) $biton(0,3)
}
-- output --
r: 1 65 A 5 hello HELLO
r: F 1.8 002
r: 2 good hello hell
r: good 2660774639 158.152.50.239
r: 2 9 3
r: abefg bdf abxyzefg
r: ABCDefg 3.14 hohoho 3
r: 11 14 1024 2.5 0.333333
r: 1 3 -2 2
r: 1st 2nd 3rd 11th 22nd "hi" hi
r: 1 3 8 14 6 4
